Specifically, A) Pressure differentials between areas with different air classifications (ISO 6 cleanroom and ISO 7 anteroom) are not routinely monitored/documented prior or during sterile drug production. A review of the firm's compounding records noted that the firm does not routinely document pressure differentials. B) Pressure differentials are measured with wall-mounted manometers which are not visible from within the cleanroom. For example, I observed the firm performing sterile compounding on 03/05/2020 and I observed that the differential pressure gauge readings between the cleanroom and the anteroom were not within acceptable ranges. The cleanroom reading was .015 and the anteroom reading was .025. The firm was processing patient specific sterile drug products which included Morphine Sulfate 7.5 mg/ml and Morphine Sulfate 12 mg/mJ both with a BUD of 03/05/2020 and for intrathecal administration.
